about.text: Drinks of the Sahel made by mashing millet into milk: fura da nono, millet balls (fura) stirred into fermented milk (nono), is served as a meal or on special occasions in northern Nigeria and Niger.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Millet adds starch and thickens the nono, so the drink is also a meal.
